children: {b:INCORPORATION AND AMENDMENT OF THE JCT PRE-CONSTRUCTION SERVICES AGREEMENT (SPECIALIST) 2016 (AS AMENDED)}

children.name: text
children: This Agreement incorporates all the provisions of the JCT Pre-Construction Services Agreement (Specialist) 2016 ("{b:PCSA 2016}") except that:

children.name: text
children: the Recitals contained in the PCSA 2016 are replaced by the Recitals contained in Part 1 of Appendix 1 of this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: the Conditions contained in the PCSA 2016 shall be amended as provided in Part 2 of Appendix 1 of this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: the Particulars contained in the PCSA 2016 are replaced by the Particulars contained in Part 3 of Appendix 1 of this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: Annex A – Fee, Rates, Additional Payments and Reimbursable Expenses contained in the PCSA 2016 is replaced by Part 4 of Appendix 1 of this Agreement; and

children.name: text
children: Annex B – Pre-Construction Services contained in the PCSA 2016 is replaced by Part 5 of Appendix 1 of this Agreement.

children.name: text

children: Add the following new definition at the appropriate alphabetical point:
"{b:Building Regulations}: the Building Regulations 2010 (SI 2010/2214) as amended by the Building Regulations etc. (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2023 (SI 2023/911)."

"{b:Specialist's Information}": Information supplied or to be provided by the Specialist under this Agreement including, without limitation, any designs, plans, calculations, and any other information provided by or on behalf of the Specialist in connection with or as part of the Pre-Construction Services, whether under the BIM Protocol or otherwise.

children: . 4  The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Specialist shall be under no obligation to the {KeyRoleContractingCompany} to enter into the Sub-Contract and the {KeyRoleContractingCompany} shall have no claim against the Specialist for loss of profit, loss of contract, loss of business, loss of chance or other similar loss or any indirect or consequential loss if the Sub-Contract is not entered into.”

children.name: text
children: he shall comply with the applicable requirements of the CDM Regulations and Part 2A of the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: he has allocated or, as appropriate, will allocate, adequate resources to comply with his obligations under the CDM Regulations and the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: he satisfies the requirement of competence pursuant to Part 2A of the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: he has the skills, knowledge, experience, behaviours and organisational capability to:

children.name: text
children: carry out any design work so that the building work to which the design relates would be in accordance with all relevant requirements of the Building Regulations;

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: any  information  provided  by  the  {KeyRoleContractingCompany}  to  the  Specialist  regarding  his competence and resources is accurate and complete in all respects.

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: there is any change in the {KeyRoleContractingCompany}'s skills, knowledge, experience, behaviours and organisational capability which affects or could reasonably affect the Contractor's or Specialist's ability to meet the competence requirements under Part 2A of the Building Regulations; and/or

children.name: text
children: there is any other reason or otherwise why the {KeyRoleContractingCompany} can no longer act as a designer and / or a contractor, as the case may be, under the CDM Regulations and/or Part 2A of the Building Regulations."
